facts.fact: The minister of higher education chaired the third multisectoral meeting following up implementation of the National Strategy of Artificial Intelligence, which the ministry says has moved from planning to implementation.

Sectoral commissions (data and infrastructure, financing, large language models, doctorate, continuing training, international cooperation) report on carrying out the strategy's roadmap under the minister's chairmanship.

systems.owner: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research

DZA.note: Financing commission only presented possible funding sources and sectoral estimates under preparation; no money stated as allocated.

facts.fact: The large language models commission presented progress on four large language models, two completed and two under development, including a tax-legislation chatbot prototype and a model for students.
The data and infrastructure commission set 17 infrastructure operations for 2026 including use of the servers and graphics processing units (GPUs) already available.
